newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney starts restaurant stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney starts restaurant stocks.

text.p: -- Smith Barney initiated coverage of the restaurant stock sector, a Smith Barney source said.
-- the source said Smith Barney started Apple South Inc and Planet Hollywood International Inc with buy ratings.
-- said Smith Barney started Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon Inc, Morton's Restaurant Group Inc and Wendy's International Inc with outperform ratings.
-- said Smith Barney started Applebee's International Inc, Brinker International Inc, Darden Restaurants Inc, McDonald's Corp and Outback Steakhouse Inc with neutral ratings.
